name: All-Angles
intro: All-Angles Bench 包含 90 个真实多视角场景与 2,132 个三选一问答对，通过计数、属性、相对距离、相对方向、物体操作和相机姿态六类任务评估 MLLM 的跨视角对应与几何一致性，并用配对问题诊断预测不一致。
org: UC Berkeley, HKU, NYU, University of Oxford, UC Davis, TranscEngram, SLAI
build_method: 场景人工筛选与随机视角采样, MLLM生成五类任务, 相机姿态专用问题模板, 八名标注员全量复核与配对质检
metric: 准确率, 配对问题不一致率
task_type: 多视角三选一视觉问答
eval_feature: 多视角, 几何一致性, 跨视角对应
build_method_en: Human scene selection and task-specific random-view sampling, MLLM generation for five tasks, a dedicated camera-pose question template, and full review plus paired-question QC by eight annotators
intro_en: All-Angles Bench contains 2,132 three-option QA pairs over 90 real multi-view scenes. Six tasks—counting, attributes, relative distance, relative direction, object manipulation, and camera pose—test cross-view correspondence and geometric consistency, while paired questions diagnose prediction inconsistency.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.15280v2 §2.2, Figure 3, §3.1, Appendix §7.1–§7.3, and Appendix §8.1. The source pools feed manual selection of 83 Ego-Exo4D plus seven EgoHumans scenes, yielding 90 final scenes with four to five spatially dispersed 796×448 views and six task designs. Appendix §7.2 states that an MLLM generates five task categories, while camera-pose estimation uses a dedicated question template; counting and camera pose use all views, whereas the other four tasks use two randomly selected viewpoints. Eight STEM PhD annotators review all items; paired-question construction and final QC produce 2,132 QA pairs with 85.3% paired coverage excluding counting. The diagram renders the 27-model evaluation and random 250-question human subset excluding paired data as dashed downstream analyses, not benchmark construction.
